research_question: How do recognition observations change across supported sequential process and algorithm-object lifetimes, with fresh Applications and fixed archive bytes?
population: All 156 configurations in the retained SandMark formal frame; no source-success filtering

lifetimes.P: Fresh JVM, algorithm, Application and parameters for each request
lifetimes.O: One JVM per word; fresh algorithm, Application and parameters for each request
lifetimes.R: One JVM and algorithm per word; fresh Application and parameters for each request

concurrency: At most four independent cells concurrently; all nine words for one cell/pass are serial in the declared order; pass two starts after pass one completes
iteration: Exhaust before any next request or configuration change; preserve partial candidates but do not admit incomplete enumeration
key_policy: Use the exact archived request key; Stern receives its requested payload as the verification candidate
auxiliary_policy: Bind target, original, GTW key, and present/absent target/original smconfig files; keep host_wm.jar and host.jar naming
unavailable_inputs: Retain the planned common-executor receipt; skip the whole word without replacing a missing B or selecting a successful alternative
native_failure: Stop the remaining word after a failed native call; never restart an O/R JVM and call it the same session
observed_unit: A fully completed public-API iterator return is a valid observation even if later process shutdown fails; all nonzero exits and shutdown failures are reported separately and are never represented as clean exits
scientific_source_failure: A completed result missing its intended payload is retained and does not stop the remaining word
local_judgments: Each completed source request tests intended-payload membership with its before context equal to the prepared input and stable before/after endpoints; revisit additionally requires first-A source success, completed required calls and unchanged A context, including every AAA A-version link; B source success is not a revisit premise, but B must begin with its prepared context

paired_analysis.stable_cold_control: Every source-A observation in the selected history, including intermediate A in AAA, and revisit in P are satisfied
paired_analysis.object_lifetime_loss: Stable P and O controls, first-A success in R, and an admitted inconsistent R revisit
paired_analysis.process_lifetime_loss: Stable P control and an admitted inconsistent revisit in O or R; identify which arms without assigning a field-level cause
paired_analysis.intervening_request_loss: For one cell/pass and lifetime, AA and every A-source plus revisit in AAA are satisfied, ABA has an admitted inconsistent revisit, and the corresponding P controls for all three histories are stable; this associates loss with the different intervening request, not a particular field or cause
paired_analysis.secondary: Typed sequence, multiset and set comparisons are descriptive; enumeration order or multiplicity is not a promised recovery contract
paired_analysis.denominator: Report planned, input-available, attempted, completed and admitted observations separately; repeated words and shared JARs are not independent defect samples

bounds: Archived implementation and hosts, two- and three-request histories, no concurrent iterator use, no reused Application, no promise about recovery after tool errors, no prevalence or universal reuse-safety inference
